messages:
noah_csm: Quick FYI 1 accounts in the new onboarding batch saw intermittent indexing failures between 09:4009:55 UTC on 2026-05-03. Im marking two mid-market accounts as renewal-risk for follow-up. Need a one-paragraph external update + office hours invite and a short validation checklist.

anita_cs: On it. Did this hit any Dedicated customers? We should avoid overpromising credits until we know. :eyes:

dave_sre: notif_bot created incident INC-2026-0503-09 at 3098764000. Short triage: a schema migration to support nested vector fields caused a validation mismatch in our index API. Writes were rejected with a 422 for some payload shapes; retries and replays were required.

hana_infra: Data point: validation_fail_rate spiked to 18% (baseline 0.2%). After rollback of the migration gate and a compatibility patch at 3098765200, fail rate dropped to <0.5%. Replays started at 3098765300 and are ~70% complete.

dave_sre: Action: toggled the migration flag, pushed a permissive parser that accepts legacy payload shapes, and queued idempotent replays. We also added a preflight check to reject bad payloads client-side where possible.

noah_csm: Draft external message (short): ```Hello 1d we experienced intermittent onboarding indexing rejections between 09:4009:55 UTC on 2026-05-03 that affected a subset of tenants. Cause: a schema migration introduced stricter validation for nested vector payloads which rejected some writes. Mitigation: we rolled back the migration gate, deployed a compatibility patch, and reprocessed affected batches. Current status: reprocessing is ~70% complete; most tenants are processing normally. Next steps: final replays expected within 5 hours; office hours at 16:30 UTC today to review impact and Q&A (link). Compensation: for impacted customers were offering a two-day onboarding credit; CS will follow up with eligible accounts. Apologies for the disruption. The Redwood Inference Team```

anita_cs: Looks good. Suggest including a tiny validation checklist customers can run: (1) call index health, (2) sample ingest of a small payload, (3) check last_indexed_seq. Use this snippet: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/indexes/<index_id>/health | jq .status```

hana_infra: Postmortem note for CS: root cause = migration parser stricter validation + missing compatibility test for legacy shapes; fix = permissive parser + migration gate + added unit test coverage for legacy payloads. Full postmortem ETA EOD 2026-05-03.

dave_sre: Monitoring: added a short-term alert for validation_fail_rate > 1% (created at 3098765600). We'll also email CS if replays fall below 50% after 6 hours.

noah_csm: Anita  please send the external note to the affected list and CC me. Ill own the renewal-risk outreach for the two flagged accounts and coordinate the two-day credit eligibility. Capture any customer asks during office hours and feed into the postmortem.

anita_cs: Sending now, office hours link included. Ill post a private follow-up in #customer-success-internal with the list of accounts we reached out to.

dave_sre: Will keep watch on replay progress and ping if anything slips.

hana_infra: Adding the compatibility test artifacts and a short log excerpt to the postmortem doc.

noah_csm: Thanks all, closing the loop for CS prep.
